Definition: properly, to accumulate; chiefly (specifically) to grow (causatively, make) rich
BiblicalUsage: 1) to be or become rich or wealthy, enrich, pretend to be rich; 1a) (Qal) to be or become rich; 1b) (Hiphil); 1b1) to make rich; 1b2) to gain riches; 1c) (Hithpael) to enrich oneself, pretend to be rich
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
